rows.en: Both of us in the hospital at once… It's pathetic.
The enemy's power seems to be far beyond anything we imagined… I'm sorry!
N-no, sir…
Go, head back to HQ ahead of me…
Sir…? But what about you, Captain?

Well…

I want to tell Kaji's wife… about his brave end.
But… that's a job for the police.
That's right! You don't have to go out of your way to deliver such a painful report yourself, Captain…
No… I want to be the one to tell her. It's the least I can…
Captain…
This is clearly a space kaiju! Its name is "Bemstar"…
Bemstar?

It's a space creature from the Crab Nebula!

Ever since the Crab Nebula exploded in 1054… its gas has been scattering at an astonishing speed, even now!

According to analysis data from the MAT Aerospace Medical Center, Bemstar feeds on "gas sources" such as hydrogen, nitrogen and helium.
Gas sources…
Hmm… So that's why you're out on patrol all night? Tough work…
Thanks for all your hard work, Go.
Good work out there, Go…

Yeah, thanks…

Kishida got hurt last night too, so right now the only ones at MAT who can still move are… me and the Captain, pretty much.
Here, have what they call a morning coffee! I made it extra bitter, so it'll wake you right up…

I'll make you some ham and eggs now, so hang on a minute…

…Hm?

That's strange…
What's wrong?

It won't light!

No gas is coming out… even though the main valve is open?
Gas…?
An earthquake!? Everyone, be careful!
Captain! Bemstar has appeared near the gas tanks in District 2!

What!?

This time I'll finish it for good… You watch, Kaji!

Kishida, you're injured! Stay at HQ!
It's that kaiju!
And Gigants too…!?
Go, you take care of the kaiju…
Go, you're in charge of the kaiju…
Ultraman's been beaten…

Sun! Make me stronger!

If you… if you love the Earth, your child, then give me the power to fight Bemstar as an equal!
Ultraman… You must not go any nearer to the sun.
Who is it? Who's calling me…
Turn back, Ultraman! Once you're caught in the sun's gravity, it's all over. Turn back, Ultraman!
Zoffy?

I give you this!

It is the Ultra Bracelet! As long as you wear it, you should be able to fight any space kaiju as an equal…

Now, return to Earth, Ultraman!
Ultraman has come back…
The Return of Ultraman, huh…
The Return of Ultraman, huh…
The Return of Ultraman…
The Return of Ultraman…
The Return of Ultraman, huh…
The Return of Ultraman…
Kiiiih! Kiiiih!
Heah…!
We did it, Kaji…
Captain, Captaaain!
Oh, Go… We beat the kaiju!

…!?

Captain, you're hurt! That's a terrible wound… Hurry back to HQ and get it treated!
No… I still have something left to do!

Something to do?

In that condition, what are you going to do?

Kaji's wife…

I want to tell Kaji's wife… about Bemstar's end!
Uuugh…
Right! I'm going with you!
Go… thank you.
Minami, Ueno, Kishida…!?
Making us sit still in a hospital room at a time like this would be cruel, sir.
But, Captain… right now HQ is completely empty.

Mm…

But defeating the kaiju is a greater duty to the people than guarding HQ…

However… listen, and listen well!

Of the five of us, if even one is taken out, the rest of you are not to think about revenge. Return to HQ!

Then, once Go is back, we'll attack again! I hope we all come through safely… but on that, we'll leave it to the goddess of fate!

That's all. Captain's orders!
Captain… I'd rather not end up being the one who survives and goes back to HQ, you know?
That's my line…
Commence attack!

Captain…

You… you mean to defeat the kaiju yourself, don't you?

A kaiju strong enough to beat even Ultraman… and you mean to avenge Captain Kaji, don't you?

And on top of that… you don't want to drag us young ones into it…

But… that's letting your personal feelings take over completely!

That's right! If anyone's going to die, it should be us first!

As long as you're still around, Captain, you can form the next generation of the MAT team right away!

But… greenhorns like us don't have that kind of organizational ability!
If that's how you feel, Captain, then you should be the one to go back to HQ!
All right, I understand! We're all in this together!
Heh heh heh… Go's left out!
The battle between MAT and Bemstar was over! It was MAT's first life-or-death struggle against a space kaiju…
Ugh… D-damn it!
Damn it, this wasn't supposed to happen…
Damn! Was that my mistake!?
Ngh, not here…!?
Kyaaah…
Defeat the Space Kaiju Bemstar and all Gigants…!
Defeat the Space Kaiju Bemstar and all Gigants!
Defeat the Space Kaiju Bemstar, the Gigants and all the Kelbaan!
Hideki Go is defeated
Hideki Go or Captain Kato is defeated
Any MAT officer is defeated

uncertain: U10500: Minami speaking for himself and Ueno, both hospitalized.
U10510/U10512: ［べムスター］ and ［ガス源］ full-width brackets replaced with double quotes.
U10528/U10529: [HERO4]'s two variants; second one read as "you're in charge of the kaiju".
U10531: speaker is Ultraman (Ultraman Jack in this story).
U10537-U10543: pun on the show title 帰ってきたウルトラマン; rendered "The Return of Ultraman" for the echo lines, plain "has come back" for Kato.
U10557: コク read as 酷 "cruel".
U10563/U10564: 舌い / 舌造 read as 若い "young" / 若造 "greenhorns"; すぐ時代 read as 次代 "next generation".
U10574-U10576: 宇宙怪獣ベムスター rendered "Space Kaiju Bemstar" (glossary has Cosmic Monster Bemstar for 宇宙大怪獣); 宇宙怪獣 elsewhere is "space kaiju".
U10577: source has "…?" after the defeat condition; dropped to keep the standard form.
omissions_kept: U10561: Ueno's "That's my line" - it answers Kishida's U10560.
